title: Proof of the hiding conjecture for Gaussian boson sampling with an arbitrary number of squeezed input modes
summary: Gaussian boson sampling (GBS) is a sampling task proposed to demonstrate quantum advantage. We consider Gaussian boson sampling on $M$ optical modes, with $K$ equally squeezed input modes and $N$ observed photon counts. We complete the proof of the hiding conjecture for Gaussian boson sampling with an arbitrary number of squeezers $K$, which is a part of the argument for classical hardness of GBS.
